summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 tests) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. mypy and ruff are not installed in that venv, so the type-ignore placement and lint were checked by reading the code only; line lengths were checked with awk (no line over 88 columns). Black and isort were not run.
